name: Progressive Training Strategy for Gaussian Splatting Decomposition
aliases: Staged optimization for geometry, albedo, and lighting
definition: A multi-stage optimization strategy to decompose scene geometry, appearance, and illumination from multi-view images, preventing overfitting and stabilizing lighting parameters.
summary: This multi-stage optimization strategy decomposes scene geometry, albedo, and lighting from multi-view images using 3D Gaussian Splatting, stabilizing learning by decoupling these attributes into distinct sequential phases.
